meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给访谈或播客视频叠加与口播同步的动态图形卡片,输出横屏或竖屏成片。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有访谈或播客素材,想配上跟口播同步的动态图形卡片再发布。
copy.tagline_en: Overlay transcript-synced graphic cards on podcast or interview video.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have interview or podcast footage and want synced graphic cards before posting.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会读取你的本地口播/访谈/播客视频,用本地 Whisper 转出逐字时间轴,据此设计带时间的图形卡片(标题、下三分、数据标注、引用、侧栏、画中画),在对话里直接写每张卡片的 HTML,再组装渲染成 MP4;原片画面不被改动。
howto.when: 当你提到 “graphic overlays”、“on-screen graphics” 等关键词,或想给已有的口播、访谈、播客视频加设计图形卡片时触发。想加普通字幕则走 embedded-captions。

say.text: 给这段口播视频加图形卡片,做成 9:16
say.note: 它会转录、设计定时卡片并渲染 MP4

say.text: 用标题、引用和数据标注把这条访谈包装一下
给这段播客加带时间的下三分和画中画

howto.what_en: Claude takes a local talking-head clip, transcribes it with local Whisper, designs timed graphic cards (titles, lower-thirds, quotes, data callouts, PiP), writes each card's HTML in chat, then renders an MP4. The clip plays untouched.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics" or ask to package/dress up an existing talking-head, interview or podcast video. Plain subtitles go to embedded-captions instead.

say_en.text: Add graphic cards to this talking-head clip, 9:16
say_en.note: Transcribes, designs timed cards, renders MP4

say_en.text: Package this interview with titles, quotes and data callouts
Add timed lower-thirds and picture-in-picture to this podcast
